$comment: The five states a game can be in, borrowed from the shape MyAnimeList uses for anime. Pinned here rather than hard-coded because both the function and the browser need them and nothing under web/ may import from src/. The order is the order they appear in the interface.
$exclusion: Every status excludes. A game in the library is never recommended again, whatever state it is in — criterion 8. Recording the status is for the person reading their own library, not for the recommender, which only asks whether the id is present.
